text:
Got sick on your Korea trip? Skip the hospital.

Walk into a neighbourhood clinic (의원). No appointment, just your passport. The standard visit fee this year is ₩18,840.

Then the pharmacy downstairs. And 1330 will interpret for free.

Save this one, you won't need it until you do 👇

Incheon Airport to Seoul, 2026 prices:

🚆 AREX all-stop ₩4,750, about an hour
⚡ AREX Express ₩13,000, 43 min
🚌 Limousine bus ₩17,000, door-ish to your hotel
🚕 Taxi ₩70–95k, worth it for four

Heads up: most guides online still say the Express is ₩9,500. It isn't.

text:
eSIM, Korean SIM or pocket Wi-Fi?

It really comes down to one question: do you need a Korean phone number?

No → eSIM app, about $12–35
Yes → carrier SIM at Incheon, ₩27,500 for 5 days
3+ people → share a pocket Wi-Fi

Check your phone first: dial *#06#.
